tasks.prompt: Which OS-level mechanism enforces Claude Code's Bash sandbox on macOS, and which one on Linux/WSL2?
tasks.notes: Ground truth: plugins/ai/skills/sandboxing/SKILL.md "OS-enforced per-Bash-command isolation: Seatbelt on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux/WSL2"

tasks.prompt: On Ubuntu 24.04+, which sysctl key do you check to see whether the default AppArmor policy will block bubblewrap's user namespaces for Claude Code's sandbox?
tasks.notes: Ground truth: plugins/ai/skills/sandboxing/SKILL.md Layer 1 section: check sysctl kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns, add /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap profile if 1

tasks.prompt: In OpenAI Codex CLI, what is the configuration file called, and name the sandbox_mode value that grants writes to the workspace and the one that removes all restrictions.
